about_the_game:
Night of the Living Skurre is a 3D, third person action-platformer, where the player plays as Skurre, a squirrel, who has to save their forest by driving lumberjacks insane with pranks and traps. Skurre has to use every ability in their disposal: climb and jump around, throw pinecones, set up more elaborate traps or just place a banana peel on the ground, can you evade the lumberjacks grasp long enough to destroy their will to work?

Use the environment to your advantage to hide and evade detection, lurk in the shadows and set up hidden traps that the lumberjack will unwittingly fall in to, be careful to not make too much noise!

Explore the cabin and find hidden passages, wonderful opportunities and tools to help you in your task.

Get chased by the lumberjack, lure them in to traps and outsmart them by causing noise and dropping stuff on their head.

Make sure to not get caught, even a quick witted Skurre can be caught off guard by underestimating humans!

short_description: A 3D, third person action-platformer. Explore and set up various pranks. Hide and avoid detection, get chased under the couch, watch and laugh as people trip down the stairs, throw pinecones to annoy someone until they snap in this comedic game about a squirrel protecting their home!
